name: stat-grid
title: Stat grid
description: A titled grid of two to six KPI cards (three in a row, four as 2×2, more in rows of three) that stagger in while each number counts up to its value, held, then faded out. Stats are a JSON list of {"value", "label"}; a value keeps its prefix, suffix, decimals and digit grouping ("$1.2M", "98%", "12,400", "4.9/5"). Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds; set Text to a dark colour for bright ones.

variables.label: Stats (JSON list of {value, label})
variables.default: [{"value":"98%","label":"Tasks finished without a retry"},{"value":"$1.2M","label":"Saved on model spend"},{"value":"12,400","label":"Teams routing every day"},{"value":"4.9/5","label":"Average rating"}]
